text:
morgan: FYI team — quick security advisory: during a routine scan we found a handful of GitHub Actions workflow files that reference long-lived PATs or service credentials in repo secrets for some internal repos. need a quick audit and rotation plan. :warning:
kevin: which repos? can you list them or the scanner output?
sasha: +1, also are these self-hosted runner contexts or just standard GH Actions?
morgan: initial scan (cf. link) flagged: infra/tools, ci/scripts, onboarding/examples (private). mostly hosted runners but a few self-hosted workflows were templated with org-level secrets. I attached the grep snippet below for pattern match.
morgan: ```sh
# scanner excerpt
grep -R "PAT|SERVICE_KEY|aws_secret_access_key" .github/workflows || true
```
harper: ugh, those onboarding/examples creds were test tokens that should've been ephemeral. who owns infra/tools? tagging @kevin.
kevin: I own infra/tools — will run a full scan and rotate anything still live. ETA 3h. what's our rollback plan if a secret rotation breaks a job?
morgan: good Q. plan: 1) rotate secrets in GitHub to new ephemeral tokens (use short-lived OIDC where possible), 2) update workflows to request tokens via OIDC or vault, 3) run canary CI on a forked repo to validate. If something breaks, we can revert secret to previous value for 1 hour while we patch — operations only.
sasha: I can help with updating workflows to OIDC for onboarding/examples. will open PRs to move from secrets.PAT -> permissions/workflow + OIDC.
security-bot: automated note: created issue SEC-2026-042 with scanner findings and proposed remediation checklist. Please reference SEC-2026-042 when rotating.
kevin: I started rotation for infra/tools secrets. pushed new token into GitHub and updated vault mapping. Running a dry-run of CI now.
harper: once kevin confirms infra/tools green, i'll patch onboarding/examples and open PRs for review.
morgan: immediate actions for everyone: - Owners: confirm any repo you touch is scanned (run grep above) - Rotate any long-lived tokens within 6 hours - Replace with OIDC or Vault-issued short-lived creds where possible - Notify #eng-security when done
kevin: noted. I expect infra/tools done in ~2.5h, will post a summary here with PR links.
sasha: leaving a checklist comment on SEC-2026-042 for my work.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline paused for repos: onboarding/examples until credential rotation completes.
morgan: thanks all. this is high priority because long-lived creds increase blast radius. ping me if you need emergency rollback windows or help searching for secrets. :lock:
kevin: summary: rotated infra/tools tokens, CI green, PR 482 submitted to replace secrets with OIDC calls. tagging @morgan for verification.
morgan: verified. closing follow-ups: ensure we run org-wide scan tomorrow and add a pre-commit / CI secret-detection job to catch this earlier.
harper: agree — i'll prototype a lightweight pre-commit hook and add to dev-images.
sasha: thanks team. leaving notes in SEC-2026-042 and will monitor for related alerts.
